text:
## Template 8: Complaint Resolution  
**Subject:** Resolution to Your Complaint [EXC-XXXXX]  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

We have completed our investigation into your complaint dated [date].

Complaint Reference: [EXC-XXXXX]

What We Found:
[Summary of investigation findings]

Our Decision:
[Uphold / Partially uphold / Reject]

Resolution:
[Action taken - refund, explanation, etc.]

Details:
[Specific details of resolution - refund amount, dates, etc.]

If You Accept This Resolution:
No further action is needed. Your refund (if applicable) has been
processed and will appear in your account within [timeframe].

If You Disagree With Our Decision:
You have the right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service
(free and independent):
- Phone: 0800 023 4567
- Website: www.financialombudsman.org.uk
- You have 6 months from this letter to escalate

Contact Us:
If you have questions, reply to this email or call 0800-555-2265
and reference your complaint ID.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Your feedback helps
us improve.

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Complaints Resolution Team
```
